caption: The drawing features two flat, silhouette-like figures of horses placed side by side on top of a narrow, rectangular base. Both horses are depicted in profile, facing to the left. The larger horse is prominently positioned, occupying most of the central space, while a smaller horse stands near its hind legs, closer to the left edge of the base. The figures are rendered in a reddish-brown color with some lighter, textured areas on the mane, tail, and parts of the body. The background is a plain off-white, unadorned and uniform throughout, with no additional objects or scenery. The drawing is composed with the two horses as the primary focus, centered horizontally on the paper.
title: Weather Vane
